sahneler.metin: A new pedestrian bridge in Miami collapsed onto busy traffic.
Cars were crushed beneath it, and six people were killed.
Days earlier, cracks had appeared at one end.
They were reported, then judged not to be a safety issue.
The connection there had been designed too weak.
Workers re-tensioned a rod in that spot, above open lanes.
The cracked node broke, and the span fell.
Now cracks like these are supposed to stop work and close the road.

aciklama:
FIU Bridge collapsed onto traffic days after being lifted into place. The cause: design error at a diagonal-to-deck connection, overstressed during re-tensioning.
